title: Mr. Coffee Black Coffee Maker, 12 Cups, with Auto Pause and Glass Carafe, Perfect for Home and Office Use

reviews.body: Great, no-nonsense coffee maker! This is the coffee maker I've been looking for for years and I thought no longer existed. It's fairly easy to pour the water into without spilling it. Coffee grounds don't end up in the pot when a whole pot is brewed....
Great basic coffee maker . Easy to use , coffee pot is dishwasher safe . It makes a really good cup of coffee. Great value
This simple complete coffee maker is just what I wanted. No big costs and it makes good coffee. Love it.
It does not have an automatic shut off feature. Other than that , it’s a good coffee pot.
